quotes.text: The king of Syria was troubled because the king of Israel knew of his stratagems, and by some means discovered, and was thus enabled to escape, the traps laid to ensnare him. And the Syrian king called together his servants, “and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Isr
